children.text: problem: Forgejo hard-exits after 30 s of external DB unavailability, causing long downtime from brief blips
problem: no option to force update when posting to /contents and new_branch already exists
problem: "Delete package" only deletes a single package version
problem: Forgejo Actionsfilter onsilently drops events
problem: IsErr* error checkers silently fail on wrapped errors
problem: Package Registry authentication requires personal tokens, preventing secure team sharing and infrastructure access
problem: Potential race assigning wrong commit to forgejo action job
enh: provenance tracking of org memberships
bug: Forgejo actions break when a schedule with invalid cron expression is present
enh: instance configuration option to force all org member additions to be invitations
bug: OAuth2/OIDC AdminGroup is only applied after the second login, not during initial account creation
bug: emojis wrongly rendered in inline code for issue/PR titles in issue/PR lists
need: Add EAB credential configurations for ACME
problem: failure accessing a commit archive can block it from ever being accessed
problem: The "Downloads" section of a release on the "Releases" page should show the best download choice first, which typically isn't the source code
bug: enable_auto_registration does not create new user on first oidc login
SSH key Verified field is not exposed via /user/keys API
docs: update Search Syntax popup to mention quoting to disable fuzzy search
problem: common config and scripting files lack highlighting in the web file editor
